rasgulla-at-dawn.idea: Syrup gold, rose water and cream: a sweet shop opening at first light.

lavender-field-5pm.idea: Pastel lilac with sage and dusk-blue: long shadows over a field, nothing shouting.

candy-floss-arcade.idea: Spun sugar pink and bubble-gum blue on a fairground-bright white.

jewel-box.idea: Emerald velvet lining with ruby, sapphire, amber and amethyst set into it.

rose-quartz-notebook.idea: A stone-pink paper notebook with a dark-plum pen and one gold-edged page.

neon-rickshaw.idea: A night-market auto rickshaw wired with tube lights, magenta first.

steel-mill-4am.idea: Cold rolled steel greys in the dark, and sparks of orange where metal meets metal.

pit-lane.idea: Tarmac black, race-flag red and signal yellow: everything reads at a glance at speed.

bandhani-night.idea: Tie-dyed indigo cloth: dye-red and saffron dots on a deep night-blue ground.

sakura-night.idea: Blossom pink falling on a plum-dark evening.

low-glare-night.idea: Made for late hours: warm browns and muted tones with almost no blue light, so the screen does not glare.

high-contrast-chalk.idea: Pure black and white with bright chalk colours: every readable colour is at least 7:1.

safe-signals.idea: Built on the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe palette: success, error and warning stay apart under red-green colour blindness, and added and removed lines are blue and orange.

sea-glass-noon.idea: Daylight through a green glass bottle on a windowsill. The daytime half of a pair.

sea-glass-midnight.idea: The same bottle by moonlight. The night half of the pair, same hues, same roles.

diwali-diya.idea: A row of clay lamps in a dark maroon room: flame yellow, saffron and ember.

holi-morning.idea: Powder colours thrown on a white morning: magenta, teal, blue and orange all at once.

mogra-evening.idea: Jasmine white and leaf green on a warm evening veranda.

cricket-pitch.idea: Mown-grass cream, ball red and whites: a Sunday match.

old-radio.idea: A walnut cabinet, a glowing amber dial and cloth-speaker beige.

mehendi-green.idea: Fresh henna paste green, drying to terracotta.

gulmohar-summer.idea: Gulmohar blossom, orange-red over a hot white afternoon.

aurora-night-train.idea: A night train through the north: green and violet light over deep blue.

marble-and-brass.idea: Cool grey marble with a brass accent: a quiet, formal light theme.

chai-at-midnight.idea: Warm amber on cocoa, the colour of the last chai.

monsoon-surat.idea: Rain-washed teals for long debugging evenings in Surat.

paper-lantern.idea: Cream paper and a vermilion lantern: a light theme that does not burn your eyes.

terminal-mango.idea: Hot mango on near-black: loud accent, quiet everything else.

kite-festival.idea: Magenta, cyan and violet against a bright Uttarayan sky.
